known_text: Do you mind if I ask you some questions?
target_text: 你介意我问你几个问题吗？

use.known: I want to learn Chinese together with you this week.
use.target: 我这个星期想和你一起学中文。

use.known: She said she wants to come here with you tomorrow.
use.target: 她说她明天想和你一起来这里。

use.known: Do you think this is a good thing for you to do?
use.target: 你觉得这是你应该做的好事吗？

use.known: I heard that you went to that place yesterday.
use.target: 我听说你昨天去了那个地方。

use.known: He told me he really wants to help you with this.
use.target: 他告诉我他真的想帮助你做这个。

use.known: I think you are a very kind and helpful person.
use.target: 我觉得你是一个很善良很乐于助人的人。

use.known: Do you mind if I sit here with you today?
use.target: 你介意我今天和你一起坐这里吗？

use.known: I don't mind waiting for you at that place.
use.target: 我不介意在那个地方等你。

use.known: She said she doesn't mind helping us with this work.
use.target: 她说她不介意帮助我们做这个工作。

use.known: Would you mind telling me where you are going?
use.target: 你介意告诉我你要去哪里吗？

use.known: He doesn't mind if you come to his place tomorrow.
use.target: 他不介意你明天来他那里。

use.known: Do you mind if I use this thing for a moment?
use.target: 你介意我用一下这个东西吗？

use.known: I want to learn more about this interesting thing.
use.target: 我想多了解一下这个有意思的事。

use.known: I think this is the best thing I can do today.
use.target: 我觉得这是我今天能做的最好的事。

use.known: I heard that she wants to come here with us.
use.target: 我听说她想和我们一起来这里。

use.known: I told him I don't mind waiting a little longer.
use.target: 我告诉他我不介意多等一会儿。

use.known: I really hope you can help me with this work.
use.target: 我真的希望你能帮我做这个工作。

use.known: I need to think about what I should do next.
use.target: 我需要想想我接下来应该做什么。

use.known: I want to ask you something about that place.
use.target: 我想问你关于那个地方的事。

use.known: She asked me if I could help her with this work.
use.target: 她问我能不能帮她做这个工作。

use.known: Do you mind if I ask you about your friend?
use.target: 你介意我问你关于你朋友的事吗？

use.known: He asked her where she wanted to go tomorrow.
use.target: 他问她明天想去哪里。

use.known: I need to ask my mother about this first.
use.target: 我需要先问我妈妈关于这个的事。

use.known: Can I ask you why you want to learn Chinese?
use.target: 我可以问你为什么想学中文吗？

use.known: I have a few things I really want to ask you about today.
use.target: 我今天有几个事真的很想问你。

use.known: How many people are coming to that place with you tomorrow?
use.target: 明天有几个人要和你一起来那个地方？

use.known: She told me she will be here in a few days to help us.
use.target: 她告诉我她几天后会来这里帮我们。

use.known: I need a few more minutes to finish this work for you.
use.target: 我还需要几分钟来给你做完这个工作。

use.known: He asked me how many times I have been to that place.
use.target: 他问我去那个地方几次了。

use.known: Do you mind waiting for me for just a few more moments?
use.target: 你介意再等我几分钟吗？

use.known: I have one question I really want to ask you.
use.target: 我有一个问题真的很想问你。

use.known: This one is better than the one we saw yesterday.
use.target: 这个比我们昨天看到的那个好。

use.known: She gave me one good idea about how to do this.
use.target: 她给了我一个关于怎么做这个的好主意。

use.known: Do you mind if I ask you one more thing?
use.target: 你介意我再问你一个事吗？

use.known: He told me there are several people at that place.
use.target: 他告诉我那个地方有几个人。

use.known: I need to find one good place to meet you tomorrow.
use.target: 我需要找一个好的地方明天和你见面。

use.known: I have a few questions I want to ask you today.
use.target: 我今天有几个问题想问你。

use.known: Do you mind if I ask you this question first?
use.target: 你介意我先问你这个问题吗？

use.known: She said there is no problem with this plan.
use.target: 她说这个计划没问题。

use.known: He has one question about what we should do next.
use.target: 他有一个关于我们接下来应该做什么的问题。

use.known: This question is very interesting and important.
use.target: 这个问题很有意思也很重要。

use.known: I need to think about how to answer your question.
use.target: 我需要想想怎么回答你的问题。

use.known: Do you think this is a good idea for us?
use.target: 你觉得这对我们是一个好主意吗？

use.known: Is she coming to that place with you tomorrow?
use.target: 她明天和你一起来那个地方吗？

use.known: Do you mind if I ask you a few more questions?
use.target: 你介意我再问你几个问题吗？

use.known: Can you help me understand this problem better?
use.target: 你能帮我更好地理解这个问题吗？

use.known: Did he tell you why he wants to go there?
use.target: 他告诉你他为什么想去那里吗？

use.known: Is this the thing you were talking about yesterday?
use.target: 这是你昨天说的那个事吗？
